data.description: With this spell you can bestow your divine grace on another good creature for a short amount of time, infusing that creature with a portion of your holy virtue. When you touch the subject, you grant that creature a sacred bonus to its saving throws equal to its Charisma bonus (if any) on all saving throws.

raw_tokens.value: Subject gains bonus on saving throws equal to Cha modifier.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
